The rewards of reaching 50 land region maps
Effect: Increase investigation limit

Go to: London Oxford>Professor>Land Region Investigations
Obtain: Sun-faded Old Map X 5

This item is useful when you chart the landing zones below
Southwest Salonika Turkey West Coast North Beirut
Egypt North Coast Olympia Phocis

and especially useful when charting Star Atlas described below:
Ursa Minor

Item effect makes it so you don't need a quest/a map for a discovery; it is possible to bypass "required" steps while charting (as long as chart points from alternate steps still equal 100% completion)!

How to Obtain this item
1. When you reach 50 on the land charting.
2. Adventurer Advanced Award 2
3. Some Land regions when you do "Recharting"
4. Some Shipwrecks
